lyrics:
This ain't your Dad's Rising Sun, unless your Dad happens to be over 75.  The original tune has it's roots in a 17th century British folk melody.  The rising sun has been a longtime symbol for brothels in British and American ballads  It circulated widel

This one is an attempted style from (Blues in the Bottle (various artists) circa - sometime in the late 40's or early 50's and Tracy Nelson¼s version on (Bluesville Years  circa 62

Doc Doc

Special Note: The sound module used is a Roland SC-33 (SC-55).  The midi file uses Controllers 32, 101, 100, 6, Chorus, Reverb, Bends and SysEx.  Some low end sound cards do not recognize these parameters. Hence the bends and mods will sound funky.
